question: Find the single discount (approximately) equal to three consecutive discounts of 6%, 5% and 11%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive discount formula for two discounts: D = a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100

Effective discount for 6% and 5% = 6 + 5 − (6 × 5) ÷ 100 = 11 − 0.3 = 10.7%

Now, find successive discount for 10.7% and 11%:

Final single discount = 10.7 + 11 − (10.7 × 11) ÷ 100 = 21.7 − 1.177 = 20.523%

**∴ The correct answer is 20.52%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three consecutive discounts are 6%, 5% and 11%.

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100) × (1 − d₃/100)

Single equivalent discount % = [(MP − SP) ÷ MP] × 100
